hero.title: A clearer view of public declarations.
hero.description: Explore the latest Gold HATVP snapshot through a small set of transparent, source-linked aggregates.

comparison.title: Average annual income vs assets
comparison.empty: No income or asset rows were found in this snapshot.
comparison.incomeExplanation: Average annual income: {average} ({total} divided by {years} reported years).
comparison.note: The pie shows each amount as a share of the combined comparison. It is an indicator, not a measure of annual spending or personal wealth.

assets.title: Assets, by section
assets.empty: No asset rows were found in this snapshot.

snapshotMeaning.title: What this snapshot means
snapshotMeaning.counts: Counts are limited to the latest successful snapshot shared across the Gold tables.
snapshotMeaning.amounts: Amounts preserve the normalized numeric values produced by the ingestion pipeline. They are presented as indicators, not as a substitute for the source declarations.

about.title: A small window into a public dataset.
paragraphs: This dashboard is built from the HATVP open-data pipeline. The pipeline preserves raw source files, normalizes records, checks quality, and publishes four Gold BigQuery tables.
The overview intentionally exposes aggregates only. Personal contact details and raw declaration rows are not part of this public API.
about.sourcePrefix: For the authoritative source and the full declaration context, use the official HATVP links below.

sources.title: Follow the data back to HATVP.
sources.description: These are the official HATVP pages and feeds used to build this dashboard.

simpleAnalysis.title: Age, pay, and the shape of the dataset.
simpleAnalysis.description: A first statistical view of public declarants. Unusual ages stay visible and are labelled rather than hidden.
simpleAnalysis.emptyLeaders: No parsed dates of birth are available in this snapshot.
simpleAnalysis.salaryDescription: Average and median normalized declarant income, grouped by age at the income year. Active income anomalies are excluded from the statistics but retained in the source-linked tables.
simpleAnalysis.emptySalary: No eligible salary rows have a usable DOB and year.
simpleAnalysis.chartLabel: Average and median salary by five-year age bin
simpleAnalysis.anomalyNote: Anomaly labels are signals for review, not corrections to the published DOB.

ageAnalysis.title: Follow one declarant through time.
ageAnalysis.description: Start with Sébastien Lecornu, then search for another declarant to compare annual income sources, occupations, and asset acquisitions.
ageAnalysis.hint: Search is accent-insensitive and uses the latest Gold snapshot. Results stay within public declaration fields.
ageAnalysis.incomeDescription: Each year shows the source-level amounts first, followed by the combined amount used for the chart.
ageAnalysis.noIncome: No eligible annual income rows were found.
ageAnalysis.occupationDescription: Occupation labels are drawn from the public mandate and income-source fields. They are a lead for the upcoming non-cumulative mandates view.
ageAnalysis.noOccupations: No year-linked occupation labels were found.
ageAnalysis.assetDescription: Acquisition years are derived from the asset source fields and retain unknown or partial source dates as provenance.
ageAnalysis.noAssets: No asset acquisition years were available for this declarant.
ageAnalysis.loadError: This declarant analysis could not be loaded.

qualityIssues.title: Issues reported to HATVP.
qualityIssues.description: A public, redacted register of data-quality issues raised with HATVP. It contains only issue types, contact dates, public HATVP links, and resolution status.
qualityIssues.privacyNote: Emails, message contents, and HATVP replies are intentionally excluded from this page.

search.title: Find a declaration by what you know.
search.description: Search the latest public HATVP snapshot by declarant name, declaration type, mandate, organisation, identifier, date, or declared amount.
search.placeholder: Name, mandate, organisation, declaration ID, amount…
search.hint: Search is accent-insensitive and matches partial words. Contact details and addresses are never searched or shown.
search.emptyTitle: Start with a name or keyword
search.emptyDescription: Try a surname such as “Dupont”, a mandate, an organisation, a declaration identifier, or an amount.
search.noResults: Nothing matched “{query}”. Try a shorter name or another public field.

declaration.description: A source-linked view of the public declaration metadata and the matching XML node from the immutable snapshot.
declaration.overviewDescription: The source XML is organized into readable sections so you can follow the mandate, income, interests, assets, and source status without decoding the feed.
declaration.noneDeclared: The source marks this section as none declared.
declaration.parseError: This declaration could not be organized into an interface.
declaration.sourceDescription: This is the matching <declaration> node from the latest immutable HATVP XML snapshot. Published placeholders remain visible as supplied by the source.
